question: Does checked symbolic execution improve a small model's reasoning on lexically disjoint variants of supported forms?
changed_factor: Direct answering versus circuit authoring and checked symbolic execution, with the same question and gold-retrieved evidence condition.

arms.A: small LLM, gold slice rendered as English, direct JSON answer
arms.A': same model and evidence, step-by-step explanation then ANSWER_JSON
arms.B: small LLM completion backend, authorQuery maxFixRounds 2, KnowledgeLinker, askMemory/StrategyRouter, deterministic answer
arms.C: subscription model through omp, same symbolic path as B
arms.D: subscription model through omp alone, same English evidence as A

system_under_test.unavailable_policy: Record unavailable; never substitute a requested model, memory or solver.

settings.thinking: off for local model internal thinking; A' explicitly requests a visible derivation

system_under_test.prompt_hashes: Unresolved until M1 freeze; each dev run records prompt_sha256 and author context_version.
system_under_test.model_hashes: Unresolved until M1 freeze; endpoint manifests are provenance, not weight attestation.
system_under_test.runtime_versions: Unresolved until M1 freeze; record Node, llama.cpp, SOP, StrategyRouter and oracle revisions.
system_under_test.retrieval_parity: A receives exactly the independently reconstructed final gold slice; membership counts and gold oracle replay fail closed. Above the character ceiling, A receives a deterministic keyed sample and an explicit partial-list warning. evidence_does_not_fit is a separate condition.
system_under_test.A_parity_ablation: At M2, a separate preregistered condition may give A the author's candidate vocabulary and one-hop view; it is not pooled with gold-slice A.

families: F10 public sealed KBQA realism at M2
data.sealing: M1 only, after preregistration freeze. M0 creates dev sets and generator configuration, never sealed instances.
data.leakage: eval/leakage.mjs audits generators; generation never reads sealed cases or gold.
data.lexical_check: tools/datasets/audit/content-word-overlap.mjs and query-forms overlap audit; independently generated dev/heldout lexical preview, no sealed reads by generators
data.gold: Independent construction or graph traversal plus reference-oracle agreement; F1 additionally uses tools/eval/query-forms/gold.mjs two-source agreement on actual world-v1.
data.rights: Synthetic structure and statistics only, no copied text; world-v1 approved provenance; public probes follow DS011 asset rights.
data.manifest_hashes: Unresolved until M1 freeze. M0 pilot hashes its actual dev manifest.

H1.falsification: A target slice fails the practical-margin decision rule.

H2.direction: B wrong rate <= A wrong rate + 2 percentage points
H2.falsification: B's dangerous definite-error rate exceeds the ceiling.

H3.direction: Qwen3-4B B accuracy within 10 percentage points of C
H3.falsification: C minus B exceeds 10 percentage points.

H4.direction: A accuracy decreases monotonically with fact count/depth; B stays flat
H4.analysis: Report adjacent size/depth contrasts and paired intervals where the instance groups can be paired; flat means no >10 pp degradation from the smallest/shallowest stratum.
H4.falsification: An A adjacent contrast increases beyond uncertainty, or B degrades by >10 pp.

decision_rule.condition: Evidence fits only; capped-evidence rows reported separately, never a reasoning win.

stopping_rules.sampling: nested deterministic size/depth/form-stratified prefixes per family and arm
stopping_rules.broken: >20 empty/unparsable/parser_failed rows among an arm's first100; drop arm and record stage/counts/reason
stopping_rules.record: journal, evaluation topic notes, experiment record and task page

budgets.paid_policy: Subscriptions first; no paid M0 pilot. Paid execution only after subscriptions fail and explicitly recorded authorization.
budgets.monitor: invoking benchmark operator; check training lock and nvidia-smi; stop only servers this run started

pilot.scope: 20 dev instances per family, A and B, Qwen3-4B-Instruct Q4_K_M
pilot.purpose: End-to-end sanity only, not a result or superiority claim

deviations.detail: The installed omp CLI exposes no provider output-token ceiling. C/D use a shared wall deadline and reject over-budget responses using reported usage, but cannot stop token generation at exactly 4096. Local A/A'/B have provider-enforced token ceilings. Freeze requires an actual subscription output cap or an explicit revised budget contract; M0's required pilot uses A/B only.

The initial 60000-fact retrieval ceiling yielded a correct but incomplete F1 answer. Full-KB-scale retrieval bounds retain the completeness guard; row019 requires 136162 retrieved facts. Boolean-group lowering in independent slice reconstruction was corrected to all/any. Dense evidence is capped and separately scored; these rows cannot establish a same-evidence reasoning win.

freeze_requirements: Freeze exact H4 flatness and multiplicity policy
Enforce subscription provider output cap or revise budget contract explicitly
Seal 600 cases per family only after owner M1 approval
